title: Quick-Fix Flaky Egyptian Sirloin Steak en Croute
description: A diabetic-friendly Egyptian inspiration featuring a flaky pastry crust, tender sirloin steak, and aromatic spices. Serve immediately for a satisfying lunch or dinner.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together panko breadcrumbs and grated Parmesan cheese.
Season the sirloin steak with salt and pepper.
Wrap each steak in puff pastry, pressing edges to seal.
Brush the tops with egg wash and sprinkle with breadcrumb mixture.
Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, seam-side down.
